known_differences: The native Stitch screens contain invented model copy and media absent from the dated public homepage. The hosted draft uses the official public server-rendered markup and media instead.

Original React Router hydration and streaming scripts were removed. A small local script restores banner dismissal, mobile menu and code tabs; carousels, search suggestions, dynamic model listings and other interactions are not fully replicated.
The mobile-content Stitch output was reported by the generation service as a desktop-type 2560px export, so it is a design study and not accepted responsive proof.
Rendered side-by-side desktop/mobile comparison of the hosted draft with the current official page remains pending; exact visual parity is unverified.
